crossRefs.note: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

parallels.note: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Libni
people.line: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

translations.web: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
translations.bsb: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
translations.kjv: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
translations.asv: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.
